No automatic metrics were used for evaluation - only human evaluation was conducted.

guideline: Judges scored expressions on relatedness using 4-point scale: Not related (1), Remotely related (2), Considerably related (3), Extremely related (4)

overall_notes: The paper focuses on creative text generation for Portuguese news headlines using both recommendation and adaptation methods. Evaluation was conducted exclusively through human assessment with clear rubrics for relatedness, funniness, and novelty. No automatic metrics or LLM judges were used. The extraction was generally accurate but needed consolidation of redundant items and addition of missing evaluation details.
